source.name: SportsPro, 'Inter Milan ink club-record Betsson Sport shirt sponsorship'
source.quote: It was reported in February that Betsson was set to take over from Paramount+ in a deal worth around €30 million (US$32.2 million) annually plus bonuses.

note: Four-year deal running 2024-25 to 2027-28. Figure is a press report, not a club filing.
